title: Disarming Creature
caption: •Disarming Creature (V)
game_text: Plays on table. Colo Claw Fish is canceled. Bane Malar affects Force drains only at his site. During an attack (except at a pit), your characters at that site may fire character weapons at participating creatures.
lore: Luke’s defensive maneuver put him out of arm’s way.
